item.title: CAN TV compliance with mandatory “Stay-at-home” Executive Order
item.description: In compliance with the extension of Gov. Pritzker’s mandatory “Stay-at-home” Executive Order, CAN TV will remain closed to the public. Check out cantv.org or follow @cantvchicago on Facebook, Instagram and Twitter for updates on our reopening.
